labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Asks whether \r overwrite behaviour with rich.print is expected; Rich strips carriage returns by design and Live is the documented way to redraw a line.

items.body:
This is intended behaviour rather than a bug. Rich removes carriage returns from text it prints, so `\r` cannot move the cursor back to the start of the line: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/control.py

To redraw a line in place, use a live display instead. The Live Display page shows how, and `rich.live.Live` is the class to use: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst

For more help with this, please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
